title: commidendrum rugosum
intro: Commidendrum rugosum, commonly known as the Rough Commidendrum, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice for treating various health issues.
